⚠️ Methodology Limitations & Statistical Notes (Compute Mode)

This browser engine evaluates Welch's t-test and Mann-Whitney U tests on normalized counts (CPM, UQ, MoR). For cohorts with small replicate counts (e.g. $N \le 4$), non-parametric rank tests have a minimum discrete permutation p-value ($\approx 0.0286$). Under Benjamini-Hochberg FDR correction across hundreds of genes, adjusted p-values cannot mathematically reach $\le 0.05$ on rank tests alone. Therefore, Raw p-value is selected by default for exploratory multi-method consensus in Compute Mode, while FDR (Adj. p) is recommended when integrating negative-binomial shrinkage tools in Downstream Mode (DESeq2, edgeR, limma).
